text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her pre-race jitters, Gold Ship's
strides
are strong and free once it's go
time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is a great sign for future races, and
it makes
me even more excited to help
Gold Ship set a
goal and stay the course!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Soy beans, soy beans! SOOOY...
BEEEAAAAANS!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Are you eating your beans and getting
swole on
protein?! Are you?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You are what you eat, and I am built on soy beans!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now show your respect and bow down to
the
almighty soy bean!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Good. Now, I'm gonna go whip up
today's batch
of soy milk!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Soy beans, soy beans! Soooy beans!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship begins marching away, but I
still have
to talk to her about our next
goal!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, that came out of nowhere. What
are you,
Quirky Questions Quincy?
choice_data_list: What kind of race do you want to r...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Anything is good, so long as it's hot!
...But not as
hot as curry udon right out
of the pot.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Beyond that... I dunno. You're the pro
trainer, not
me. Now go get'em, tiger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I come out of the conversation with more

questions than answers, but she's
already long
gone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Using my best judgment, I decide
putting her in a race where she can
flaunt her long-distance
aptitude will
fire her up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And for that, the Hopeful Stakes sounds
like a
good place to start!
